hints: A pizzeria at position i costs price[i]+distance(i,x) to serve x.
Rewrite distance as either i-x or x-i to separate the query position from the shop value.
Maintain minima of price[i]-i and price[i]+i in a segment tree; combine left and right of x.
analogy: Split shops on either side of x so the distance formula becomes a stored value plus x or minus x.
example: At x=5, a shop at i=2 with price 4 costs 4+3=7, represented by price-i+x=4-2+5=7.
algorithm: Store price[i]-i and price[i]+i in range-min trees. Query left of x for min(price-i)+x and right of x for min(price+i)-x; update both leaves when a price changes.
correctness: For i<=x, |i-x|=x-i; for i>=x it is i-x. The two minima therefore cover every pizzeria's exact delivery cost.
complexity: O(n) build and O(log n) per query/update, O(n) space.
